versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Beavers and coots who vote a shared water level up or down each turn; units at or below the water attack at half strength.
Raise to sink small enemy boards, Lower for gold and stats, and mills pay for every change.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Fight-only water gets its own verb, Flood N, Tiddy Mun drowns all fight as the keyword says, and Kees can reach the back row.
Raise now pays (Schouw-Walker), Gauge-Keeper floods by half its Health so High Water bites late, and every Vote payoff uses one wording.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Under now says a sunk unit deals half its Attack whether it attacks or is attacked, and the Drowning keyword lives only on Tiddy Mun's card.
Bram Stuw's extra Vote may go either way, and Keeper of the Overflow's water drains when it dies, so Pumped Flood has counterplay.
